entries.speaker: Black-Haired Male Student
entries.en: It's already been half a year, huh?[n]That sure went by fast.

entries.speaker: Vice Principal
entries.en: ...And finally, we would like Dr. Maruki[n]to share a few last words with the student[n]body.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: As the vice principal has mentioned,[n]today marks the end of my tenure at[n]Shujin Academy.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Over the past several months, I've come[n]to learn about all sorts of conflicts that[n]you students have faced this year.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Troubles with romance, with studies—[n]in fact, some of you have financial issues[n]that are awfully similar to my own...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: At any rate, many of you have come to[n]see me during my time here—some of[n]you even refer to me as Doc now...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But I must say, as I watched you all strive[n]toward your dreams, I feel like I'm the[n]one who received an education here.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I actually had a certain goal in mind[n]when I was first assigned to this school...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...However, I lacked the ability to[n]accomplish it on my own.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Of course, I have no intention of giving[n]up... Still, I would be lying if I said I'm[n]leaving here today with no regrets.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Basically, what I want to say to you all is[n]to learn from me, and live your lives[n]without regret.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Finally, I know this is rather cliché, but[n]I wish you all the good luck and success[n]in your futures.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Heheh... I guess things don't always[n]pan out like you expect.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Well, that's it... Thank you for having me[n]here this year.
